preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round, list) and len(round) == 2 for round in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each round is a list containing two elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round[0], dict) and set(round[0].keys()) == {'P1', 'P2'} for round in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each round's first element is a dictionary with keys 'P1' and 'P2'.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round[0]['P1'], str) and isinstance(round[0]['P2'], str) for round in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each player's result in a round is a string.

preconditions.expression: all(all(char in 'XO' for char in round[0]['P1']) and all(char in 'XO' for char in round[0]['P2']) for round in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each player's result contains only 'X' or 'O'.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round[1], bool) for round in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each round's second element is a boolean.

postconditions.description: The function returns one of the specified outcomes.

postconditions.expression: pete_score == sum(2 if round[1] else 1 for round in rounds for char in round[0]['P1'] if char == 'X')
postconditions.description: Pete's total score is calculated correctly.

postconditions.expression: phil_score == sum(2 if round[1] else 1 for round in rounds for char in round[0]['P2'] if char == 'X')
postconditions.description: Phil's total score is calculated correctly.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Pete Wins!' if pete_score > phil_score else ('Phil Wins!' if phil_score > pete_score else 'Draw!')
postconditions.description: The winner is determined correctly based on the scores.
